question: In April 2025, DRDO’s ** **Defense Research and Development Laboratory (DRDL) unit had successfully completed a long-duration ground test of an advanced scramjet combustor in _________.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Hyderabad**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **DRDL (Defense Research and Development Laboratory)**, a unit under the **Defense Research and Development Organization (DRDO)**, conducted a successful long-duration ground test of an advanced scramjet combustor in **April 2025**.
 
• The test took place in **Hyderabad**, which houses one of DRDO's key facilities for advanced defense technology research and development.
 
• **Scramjet combustor technology** is pivotal for hypersonic systems, enabling efficient propulsion at speeds greater than Mach 5.
 
• Hyderabad is a central hub for defense and aerospace research in India, hosting several institutions like DRDL, RCI (Research Centre Imarat), and ASL (Advanced Systems Laboratory).
 
• The successful test signifies India’s progress in developing **indigenous hypersonic technology**, which is critical for defense applications and space exploration.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Scramjet Technology:**

 
 
• A **scramjet** (supersonic combustion ramjet) engine is designed for hypersonic flight, where air flows through the engine at supersonic speeds.
 
• Unlike conventional jet engines, scramjets do not have rotating components, reducing complexity and weight.
 
• Scramjets use atmospheric oxygen for combustion, eliminating the need to carry oxidizers, making them suitable for long-range applications.
 
• This technology is crucial for **hypersonic missiles**, high-speed aircraft, and **space vehicles**.
 
 
 
• **DRDO's Role:**
 
 
• The **Defense Research and Development Organization (DRDO)** is India’s premier defense R&D institution, under the Ministry of Defense.
 
• Established in **1958**, DRDO focuses on developing state-of-the-art defense systems and technologies.
 
• DRDO's achievements include **missile systems** like Agni, Prithvi, Akash, and BrahMos, as well as advanced radar, avionics, and electronic warfare systems.
 
 
 
• **Hyderabad’s Strategic Importance:**
 
 
• Hyderabad is a significant center for India’s aerospace and defense industries, hosting key DRDO facilities such as **DRDL, ASL, and RCI**.
 
• It is also home to companies like Bharat Dynamics Limited (BDL) and Mishra Dhatu Nigam Limited (MIDHANI), which contribute to missile and material production.
 
• The city plays a critical role in India’s defense technology innovation and advancement.
 
 
 
• **Hypersonic Technology in India:**
 
 
• India is actively developing hypersonic systems, including **Hypersonic Technology Demonstrator Vehicles (HSTDV)**.
 
• DRDO successfully tested HSTDV in **2020**, marking a significant milestone in indigenous hypersonic capability.
 
• Such advancements are vital for defense applications, as hypersonic missiles can evade traditional air defense systems due to their high speed and maneuverability.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Scramjet Applications:**

 
 
• Hypersonic missiles: Faster and harder to intercept, enhancing strategic deterrence.
 
• Space exploration: Scramjets can reduce launch costs by utilizing atmospheric oxygen for propulsion.
 
• High-speed aircraft: Potential to revolutionize commercial air travel with reduced flight times.
 
 
 
• **Global Context:**
 
 
• Countries like the **USA, Russia, and China** are leading in hypersonic technology development.
 
• India’s advancements through DRDO place it among the few nations with indigenous hypersonic capabilities.
